text: Wɔ United States, Mexico ne Canada nyinaa mu no, 2026 adwumayɛfo nkurow no yɛ stadium a wɔatwɛn no mfeɛ 50 mu ho mfonini. Deɛ ɛdi kan no, Mexico City’s Estadio Banorte, wɔbuee no wɔ 1966 na ɛyɛ beaeɛ a ɛkaa World Cup wɔ 1970, 1986 ne 2026. Deɛ ɛyɛ foforɔ no, Los Angeles’s SoFi Stadium, wɔbuee no wɔ 2020. Wɔn ntam no, Canada’s BC Place ne BMO Field, nnua a wɔatwa a wɔde gridiron bɛyɛ football, ne Mexico’s Estadio Akron ne Estadio BBVA. Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ no firi Pedro Ramírez Vázquez kɔsi Populous ne HKS, beaeɛ biara aba sɛ wɔatwa no ama tournament no: wɔde natural grass atwɛn, wɔatwa nneɛma a wɔtena so, na continent no ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛgye.
